blogs.title: Beyond the DC Triad: Spotting Telomere Biology Disorders in Young Adults Without Classic Mucocutaneous Clues
blogs.description: Uses this case to build a pragmatic diagnostic trigger list for TBDs in adults who lack oral leukoplakia/nail dystrophy/reticular pigmentation. Covers red flags (unexplained cytopenias with low retic, premature greying, organ fibrosis, osteoporosis/fragility fractures, hepatosplenomegaly, neuropathy), suggested initial labs, when to order telomere length testing and exome panels, and how to differentiate TBD from more common mimics (nutritional deficiency, autoimmune disease, chronic infection).

blogs.title: When a PARN Variant Is a VUS: Clinically Anchoring Genetics in Suspected Telomere Disease
blogs.description: Walks through interpreting a monoallelic PARN missense VUS using ACMG/AMP criteria and phenotype anchoring. Details practical next steps: telomere length (flow-FISH), segregation testing, reanalysis of exome, seeking functional data, and how to communicate uncertainty. Discusses management decisions you can justify with a VUS plus strong phenotype, and pitfalls in over- or under-calling pathogenicity.

blogs.title: DAT-Positive, Retic-Low: Untangling B12 Deficiency, Ineffective Erythropoiesis, and TBD-Related Marrow Vulnerability
blogs.description: Dissects the lab tensions in this case: severe B12 deficiency, positive DAT, high iron/ferritin, dimorphic smear, and low reticulocytes. Reviews how to distinguish immune hemolysis from ineffective erythropoiesis, why telomere-mediated HSC exhaustion can blunt reticulocyte responses, and a stepwise approach to treating nutritional causes while maintaining surveillance for evolving marrow failure in TBD.

blogs.title: The Liver Is Not an Innocent Bystander: Recognizing and Managing Hepatic Fibrosis in Telomere Syndromes
blogs.description: Highlights hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis as an under-recognized TBD phenotype. Proposes a screening bundle (elastography, ultrasound, portal hypertension labs), differential workup when serologies are negative, medication cautions, and monitoring frequency. Discusses referral thresholds, transplant candidacy nuances, and how liver disease can coexist with pulmonary and marrow involvement in PARN-associated TBD.

blogs.title: IPF With a Telomere Signature: Clinical Implications of Suspected TBD in Young Fibrosis
blogs.description: Uses the patient’s interstitial changes to review clues to telomere-related pulmonary fibrosis in younger adults. Covers implications for family screening, antifibrotic therapy expectations, oxygen/rehab, and lung transplant planning (conditioning sensitivity, extrapulmonary disease assessment). Provides a practical algorithm for integrating genetic and telomere testing into ILD clinics.

blogs.title: Beyond Blood and Lungs: Bone and Nerve Manifestations in Telomere Disease
blogs.description: Explores osteoporosis/fragility fractures, secondary hyperparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, and axonal neuropathy in TBDs. Reviews mechanisms (premature cellular senescence, endocrine contributors, nutritional overlays), targeted evaluation (DEXA, calcium–phosphate–vitamin D axis, EMG/NCS), and management pearls including rehab, fracture prevention, and medication safety in the context of hepatic involvement.
